headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.19
summary: This release ships the arm32 (armeabi-v7a) SDK repository: the launcher now bundles the SDK libraries taken from the MCPatch build of the same Minecraft version, because every 32-bit crash so far came from the Google Play build's own SDK binaries failing their static initializers inside the launcher's process. Real-device testing on 32-bit phones still decides the next step, since the maintainer has no armeabi-v7a hardware.

items.text: 32-bit testers: if your phone is 32-bit-only (for example a POCO C3) and you have Minecraft 1.26.62.1 installed from Google Play, please try the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and report in the linked issue whether the game launches. Your tombstones drove the whole fix chain (#86, #89, #92, #94) — this one finally swaps out the binaries themselves.

Shipped the arm32 (armeabi-v7a) SDK repository: the launcher bundles libPlayFabMultiplayer.so and libmaesdk.so taken from the MCPatch build of the same Minecraft version, whose arm32 SDK binaries differ from the Google Play ones that crashed in every 32-bit launch since v15. On 32-bit devices the game's cache copies of bundled SDK libraries are removed so dependency resolution always picks the launcher-bundled ones, and the 32-bit load order returns to the proven 64-bit shape (issue #94).
